zh.title: 星宇航空接收第十架A330-900客機　B-58310完成交付
zh.summary: 星宇航空第十架A330-900客機B-58310於2026年10月1日完成交付，製造序號為2135，採297席客艙配置，包括28席商務艙及269席經濟艙。
body: 星宇航空機隊再添一架Airbus A330-900客機。航空器資料顯示，註冊編號B-58310的新機已於2026年10月1日完成交付，成為星宇航空第十架A330-900。該機製造序號（MSN）為2135，在空中巴士生產及測試階段使用法國測試註冊編號F-WWYL。Planespotters.net亦將B-58310列入10月1日最新交付航空器名單。
B-58310由空中巴士位於法國的土魯斯生產線製造。交付前的航空器動態紀錄顯示，該機在9月中旬已停放於土魯斯布拉尼亞克機場（TLS）的Airbus Delivery Centre，進入正式交機前的準備階段。相關生產紀錄同時確認其型號為A330-941、製造序號2135。
依目前公開的機隊資料，B-58310採用與星宇航空既有A330neo相同的297席客艙配置，包括28席商務艙及269席經濟艙，並搭載兩具Rolls-Royce發動機。星宇航空官方資料指出，其A330neo機隊使用Rolls-Royce Trent 7000系列發動機，客艙則配置全平躺商務艙座椅及個人機上娛樂系統。
星宇航空自2022年接收首架A330neo以來，逐步將此型廣體客機投入亞洲區域航線。A330-900屬於空中巴士A330neo系列，採用Trent 7000發動機及新一代氣動設計，定位可涵蓋區域至長程航線，提供航空公司在運能與航程配置上的彈性。
隨著B-58310完成交付，星宇航空A330-900機隊規模增至10架。從B-58301至B-58310的機隊擴充，也使A330neo持續成為星宇航空廣體機隊的重要組成之一，與A350系列共同支援其區域及長程航網發展。

en.title: STARLUX Airlines takes delivery of its tenth A330-900, B-58310
en.summary: STARLUX Airlines took delivery of its tenth A330-900, B-58310, on October 1, 2026. The aircraft has manufacturer serial number 2135 and a 297-seat cabin with 28 business class and 269 economy class seats.
body: STARLUX Airlines has added another Airbus A330-900 to its fleet. Aircraft records show that the new aircraft, registered B-58310, was delivered on October 1, 2026, becoming the airline’s tenth A330-900. Its manufacturer serial number (MSN) is 2135, and it used the French test registration F-WWYL during production and testing at Airbus. Planespotters.net also included B-58310 in its list of aircraft delivered on October 1.

B-58310 was manufactured at the Airbus production line in Toulouse, France. Aircraft movement records before delivery show that it was parked at the Airbus Delivery Centre at Toulouse-Blagnac Airport (TLS) in mid-September, preparing for the formal handover. Production records also identify the aircraft as an A330-941 with MSN 2135.

According to currently available public fleet records, B-58310 has the same 297-seat cabin configuration as the airline’s existing A330neos, with 28 business class and 269 economy class seats, and is powered by two Rolls-Royce engines. STARLUX’s official information states that its A330neo fleet uses Rolls-Royce Trent 7000-series engines and features fully flat business class seats and individual inflight entertainment systems.

Since taking delivery of its first A330neo in 2022, STARLUX has gradually deployed this widebody type on regional routes across Asia. The A330-900 is part of the Airbus A330neo family and combines Trent 7000 engines with a new aerodynamic design. Its intended role spans regional and long-haul services, giving airlines flexibility in capacity and range planning.

The delivery of B-58310 brings the STARLUX A330-900 fleet to ten aircraft. The expansion from B-58301 through B-58310 keeps the A330neo an important part of the airline’s widebody fleet, supporting the development of its regional and long-haul network alongside the A350 family.

zh.title: KLM首架Airbus A350-900抵達阿姆斯特丹　投入長程機隊更新
zh.summary: 荷蘭皇家航空首架Airbus A350-900客機PH-ZNA於2026年10月2日抵達阿姆斯特丹史基浦機場，將投入長程機隊更新，預計10月底開始商業載客服務。
body: 荷蘭皇家航空（KLM）首架Airbus A350-900於2026年10月2日抵達阿姆斯特丹史基浦機場（AMS），正式加入KLM機隊。這架註冊編號PH-ZNA的A350-900由法國土魯斯出發，完成交付飛行後約於當地時間下午4時10分降落史基浦，成為KLM引進A350系列客機的重要里程碑。
PH-ZNA以荷蘭畫家林布蘭的名作《夜巡》（De Nachtwacht）命名。KLM先前宣布，旗下A350機隊將採用荷蘭知名藝術作品作為命名主題；首架飛機選擇《夜巡》，後續交付的飛機則將延續相同概念。
這架飛機自Airbus位於土魯斯布拉尼亞克機場（TLS）的交付中心起飛，交付航班使用具紀念性質的「KL350」航班號。抵達史基浦後，飛機降落於Buitenveldertbaan跑道，隨後在機場車輛護送下前往KLM機棚。

KLM的A350-900採三艙等配置，共設331個座位，包括34席World Business Class、26席Premium Comfort以及271席經濟艙座位。Air France-KLM表示，A350是集團持續更新長程機隊的一部分；相較KLM現役較舊世代的廣體客機，新機型可降低燃油消耗及噪音影響。KLM指出，相較Boeing 777-200ER，A350的燃油消耗約可降低25%，噪音足跡則可縮減約40%。
KLM計畫以A350逐步更新長程廣體機隊，首先取代Airbus A330-200及A330-300，之後亦將接替部分Boeing 777-200ER。KLM已規劃引進22架A350-900，相關飛機來自Air France-KLM集團向Airbus下訂的A350機隊訂單。
首架A350預計於10月底開始商業載客服務，首條航線為阿姆斯特丹往返多倫多皮爾遜國際機場（YYZ）。之後KLM亦規劃將A350投入蒙特婁特魯多國際機場（YUL）、吉力馬札羅國際機場（JRO）、達累斯薩拉姆朱利葉斯·尼雷爾國際機場（DAR）、奈洛比喬莫·肯雅塔國際機場（NBO）及桑給巴爾阿貝德·阿曼尼·卡魯姆國際機場（ZNZ）等長程航線。
隨著PH-ZNA抵達荷蘭，KLM正式成為Airbus A350的營運航空公司。其同集團的法國航空自2019年起即已營運A350，而KLM此次引進同型機，也使Air France-KLM集團在長程機隊更新與機型共通化方面進一步擴大A350的使用規模。

en.title: KLM’s first Airbus A350-900 arrives in Amsterdam as long-haul fleet renewal advances
en.summary: KLM’s first Airbus A350-900, PH-ZNA, arrived at Amsterdam Schiphol Airport on October 2, 2026. The aircraft will support the airline’s long-haul fleet renewal and is expected to enter commercial passenger service in late October.
body: KLM’s first Airbus A350-900 arrived at Amsterdam Schiphol Airport (AMS) on October 2, 2026, formally joining the airline’s fleet. Registered PH-ZNA, the aircraft departed Toulouse, France, on its delivery flight and landed at Schiphol at approximately 4:10 p.m. local time, marking an important milestone in KLM’s introduction of the A350 family.

PH-ZNA is named after The Night Watch (De Nachtwacht), the famous painting by Dutch artist Rembrandt. KLM previously announced that its A350 fleet would be named after well-known Dutch works of art. The first aircraft carries the name The Night Watch, and subsequent deliveries will follow the same theme.

The aircraft departed the Airbus delivery centre at Toulouse-Blagnac Airport (TLS) using the commemorative delivery flight number KL350. On arrival at Schiphol, it landed on the Buitenveldertbaan runway before being escorted by airport vehicles to the KLM hangar.

KLM’s A350-900 has a three-class cabin with 331 seats: 34 in World Business Class, 26 in Premium Comfort and 271 in economy class. Air France-KLM said the A350 forms part of the group’s ongoing renewal of its long-haul fleet. Compared with older-generation widebody aircraft currently operated by KLM, the new type can reduce fuel consumption and noise. KLM said that, compared with the Boeing 777-200ER, the A350 can use approximately 25% less fuel and reduce its noise footprint by around 40%.

KLM plans to use the A350 to gradually renew its long-haul widebody fleet, initially replacing the Airbus A330-200 and A330-300 and later some Boeing 777-200ERs. The airline has planned to introduce 22 A350-900s, drawn from the Air France-KLM group’s A350 orders with Airbus.

The first A350 is expected to enter commercial passenger service in late October, initially flying between Amsterdam and Toronto Pearson International Airport (YYZ). KLM also plans to deploy the A350 on long-haul routes to Montréal-Trudeau International Airport (YUL), Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO), Julius Nyerere International Airport in Dar es Salaam (DAR), Jomo Kenyatta International Airport in Nairobi (NBO), and Abeid Amani Karume International Airport in Zanzibar (ZNZ).

With PH-ZNA’s arrival in the Netherlands, KLM formally becomes an Airbus A350 operator. Air France, its fellow group airline, has operated the A350 since 2019. KLM’s introduction of the same type further expands the A350’s role in Air France-KLM’s long-haul fleet renewal and fleet commonality.
